---
title: "Angler Meeting Supplementals"
output: html_document
date: "2026-04-16"
---

```{r}
angler_2 <- read_csv("hw_anglermeeting3.csv") %>% 
  distinct(fish, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(!station %in% c("9", "14", "4")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(station)) 

angler_new <- angler_2 %>% 
  mutate(cell_id = substr(drift, 10, 11),
         trip_date = substr(drift, 4, 9))

angler_new2 <- angler_new %>% 
  group_by(angler, station, trip_date, cell_id) %>% 
  count()

angler_new3 <- angler_new2 %>% 
  group_by(angler, station) %>% 
  summarise(avg_fish_per_stat = mean(n))

top_station <- angler_new3 %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_fish_per_stat, n = 1)
```
